name: yt-short-clipper-extension
description: Chrome extension (side panel) + local server to turn long-form YouTube videos into 9:16 Shorts clips with AI highlight detection and auto-upload.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build:ext: npm run build:content && npm --prefix client run build:ext
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && node client/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b client --pretty false
